purpose: Teach: なんせ/わき/黒く/ひとりひとり/チョット/微笑み/初夏/自在

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、なんせ初めての遠足だから、緊張するわよね
lines.en: Sho, it's your first field trip, so of course you're feeling a little nervous.
lines.style: Warm, reassuring tone. Speaking to calm him before he leaves. Gentle rhythm, like she's already thought through his worry. A mother's soft certainty underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、わきに荷物置いてもいい?
lines.en: Mom, can I put my bag down over here?
lines.style: Quiet, practical question. Not demanding attention — just checking if it's okay. Small voice, polite. The carefulness of a child who doesn't want to be in the way.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、外が黒くなってきたから、お家に帰りましょう
lines.en: Sho, it's getting dark outside. Come on, let's head home.
lines.style: Gentle but firm. Not urgent, but decided. The tone of someone who's already made up her mind for both of them. A slight edge of 'we should go now' without force.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お友達ひとりひとりにご挨拶したよ
lines.en: Mom, I said hello to every single one of my friends.
lines.style: Small, bright voice climbing on the last word. Pride carefully contained — he's telling her something important about himself. Almost asking for her to notice what he did.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、チョット待ってね、お父さんに電話するわ
lines.en: Sho, hold on just a moment — I need to call your father.
lines.style: Brisk, matter-of-fact. Moving into the next thing. No fuss, just action. The efficient tone of a parent who's juggling and knows how.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんの微笑み、優しいね
lines.en: Mom, Dad's smile is so kind, isn't it?
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamy observation. Speaking more to himself than to her. A child noticing something tender and wanting to name it aloud. Gentle, unguarded.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、初夏のお祭りが待ち遠しいね
lines.en: Sho, the summer festival is going to be here before we know it.
lines.style: Wistful, looking ahead with him. Speaking in the comfortable rhythm of quiet time together. A mother reflecting with her son, not at him. Slow, warm exhale.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが自在に絵を描かれるんだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad can draw anything he wants — he's so good at it.
lines.style: Animated, eager. Words tumbling out a little faster because he wants her to understand how wonderful this is. Admiration unfiltered. A child sharing something he's excited about.
